answer_1.quote: We propose here the Multiple TimeLine Summarization (MTLS) task that automatically generates a set of timelines that summarize disparate yet important stories
answer_1.outputs: A set of timelines, each including a sequence of time/date and summary pairs

answer_2.quote: Therefore, we also propose a quantitative evaluation measure for MTLS based on the adaptation of the previous TLS evaluation framework... based on metric m, which can be either concat, agreement, align, align+, align+m:1, or d-select
